title: Helmet Holder Wall Mount – 180° Rotation in Metal
descriptionHtml:
Give the helmet a place of its own

A helmet left on a bench or the floor easily gets dirty and can fall down. It also takes up unnecessary space in the garage.

A sturdy mount that rotates

This metal helmet holder mounts on the wall and holds the helmet securely in place. It can be rotated 180 degrees so you can reach it easily.

Features

  • Sturdy metal wall mount
  • 180-degree rotation
  • Keeps the helmet clean and in place
  • Saves space in the garage
  • Fits both motorcycle and bike helmets

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
